note: The interest_rate tag sits in this column's cells on all 973 rows and n1 equals it on every compared row, so n1 is the all-in rate. In the PIK shape, n2 equals the tagged pik_rate on all 4 rows and is the PIK part included in the all-in rate. The column holds no reference-rate codes; those are in the separate Reference Rate and Spread column.
